messages.subject: RE: Project Zephyr — royalty trade-off
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

On the royalty: I agree with holding the cap at £2.0m. Our internal model says NBV crosses the point where 4.5%×NBV hits the £2.0m cap in year 4, so a 4.5% rate with a £2.0m cap is materially better for us than 4.0% with £2.5m — we hit the cap a year earlier and stay there. So: push rate to 4.5%, hold cap at £2.0m.

On liability I can live with £9m provided the fee obligation and confidentiality breaches stay outside the cap.

Priya
